proof_scope: Real X11 draft retention in an operator-calibrated empty composer, plus explicit missing-display refusal. No Gemini/provider answer or design acceptance claim.

cases.name: paste-only-still-requires-display
command: T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; printf 'draft' > "$T/prompt.txt"; ../run.sh plan --composer-x 1 --composer-y 1 --out "$T/coords.json" >/dev/null; env -u DISPLAY ../run.sh submit --prompt-file "$T/prompt.txt" --coords "$T/coords.json" --paste-only --execute --json
